openings.claim: A threshold-directed adjudication workflow can support a reproducible further-evaluation decision while making unresolved label uncertainty explicit.
openings.delta: Change the sampling dependency from apparent slice improvement to whether a disputed label can change the acceptance decision. A local script carries paired correctness differences and conservative total and slice bounds. Prediction agreement contributes zero to the change regardless of label; disagreement may contribute minus one, zero or plus one. Recompute bounds after each selected adjudication. Advance only when every permitted completion satisfies total gain at least four and every slice loss at most two. Reject only when no permitted completion satisfies that joint rule; otherwise report unresolved.
openings.prediction: Against a fixed record-ID ordering of flagged rows, threshold-directed selection may reach a key-consistent decision with fewer adjudications, especially near the slice already losing two. Annotator disagreement alone need not identify influential rows. Advantage disappears when influential uncertainty is diffuse or inaccessible.
openings.probe: On the two matched copies, compare threshold-directed selection with fixed record-ID ordering. Freeze both reports before opening the full-label key. Log each chosen ID, rationale, returned label or withheld status, updated bounds, elapsed time and adjudication count. Break selection ties by record ID. Attempt each withheld row once, log its unresolved contribution, and spend no allowance on failed access. Stop by sixteen successful adjudications or seventy minutes. Compare key consistency, affected slices, supported-decision frequency and adjudications used; unresolved reports count as unresolved, not successful decisions.
assumptions: Nonflagged supplied labels are fixed for this review; flagged labels alone require adjudication.
The supplied records permit conservative correctness bounds without introducing outside labels.
Script preparation and analysis fit seventy minutes; otherwise freeze unresolved.
Withheld rows or remaining flagged uncertainty can defeat decision closure even with all sixteen adjudications; the stop cap establishes no informative result.

assessment: A proposed review probe, not an observed improvement or deployment verdict. Any advance authorizes only another evaluation round; bounds and logs expose why rejection or unresolved remains necessary.
